newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume eases, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume eases, prices mixed.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume fell slightly to 1,214 kilos on Friday from Thursday's 1,332, while prices closed mixed.
Gold eased to $339.80 an ounce from Thursday's $340.05 in line with international markets, while in lira terms the prices edged up to 1,600,900 lira per gram from Thursday's 1,600,000 lira.
Brokers said lower prices buoyed activity in dollar terms, while a firmer Turkish currency depressed trade in lira terms ahead of the weekend.
The Turkish currency closed at 145,870 to the dollar, against Thursday's 145,900.
Most of the day's trade -- 809 kilos -- took place in the morning and 57.2 percent of total trade was in dollars.
